name: miisodev-skills
description: Agent/LLM skills for engineering by miisodev: blueprint, which establishes a project's foundation with its owner, and production, an autonomous production-readiness audit that returns a go/no-go with evidence.

interface.longDescription: Two agent skills for building software products. blueprint establishes a project's foundation with its owner: the core idea, market, business model, product requirements, brand, stack and plan, in seven documents with a workbook so the work resumes in any session. production is an autonomous readiness audit: it inventories every surface, assesses every applicable check, and returns a structured go/no-go with the specific items that stand in the way. Both are plain Markdown on the open Agent Skills specification plus one standard-library Python scoring script. They run entirely on your machine: no accounts, no telemetry, no remote code.
capabilities: Establish a project blueprint with its owner
Run a production-readiness audit with a go/no-go decision
defaultPrompt: Establish a blueprint for my project idea
Run a production readiness audit before I launch
What should I decide before I start building?

publication.release_notes: v2.0.2: shebang removed per directory validation (the script runs via python). v2.0.1: line-ending normalization per directory validation. v2.0.0: fail-closed audit completeness (a missing check holds the decision), scoped decisions, remediate profile, schema 1.1, blueprint brief mode and one-page naming/compliance references.
